Sizzle N Sambar is a well-established Indian restaurant based in Victoria Park and Willetton in Western Australia, known for delivering authentic, high-quality cuisine. About the Role
The Restaurant Manager will be responsible for managing daily restaurant operations, maintaining high standards of food quality and customer service, supervising staff, and ensuring smooth coordination between front-of-house and kitchen team. This is a hands-on leadership role suited to a hospitality professional with strong operational and people-management skills.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Oversee day-to-day restaurant operations. 
•	Ensure high standards of customer service and customer satisfaction. 
•	Recruit, train, supervise, and roster restaurant staff. 
•	Monitor staff performance and provide ongoing support and development. 
•	Coordinate front-of-house operations to ensure efficient service during busy periods. 
•	Handle customer feedback and resolve complaints professionally and promptly. 
•	Manage stock ordering, supplier relationships, and inventory control. 
•	Monitor restaurant budgets, labour costs, and operational expenses. 
•	Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety regulations.

•	Maintain accurate records relating to sales, stock, staffing, and operational reporting.

•	Strong leadership and team management skills. 
•	Excellent communication and customer service abilities. 
•	Knowledge of food safety and workplace health and safety regulations. 
•	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 
•	Ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and public holidays. 
Job Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary:  AU$ 80,000– AU$90,000 per annum (plus Superannuation)
